# P2E Research Group

> Plant BOP & Energy Systems Engineering group at the Korea Research Institute of Chemical Technology (KRICT), led by Han Sol Jung.

## Canonical site
https://dochi37-cpu.github.io/

## Academic field
Plant BOP & Energy Systems Engineering

## Canonical identity
Technology Translation & Engineering Decision-Making

## Core philosophy
From core technology to operable plant systems.

## Research identity
P2E studies how BOP, utilities, plant integration and operating constraints determine whether core chemical and energy technologies can scale and operate in real plant systems. Core technology inputs may include experiments, kinetics, reactor/device models and separation performance from internal or external collaborators. P2E's core ownership begins at BOP and utilities and extends through plant integration, dynamic operability, scale-up and demonstration decisions.

## Signature methods
- Equipment-performance-aware modeling
- Steady-state and dynamic simulation
- Decision-relevant model fidelity
- Engineering-data integration
- Demonstration/operation-data validation and reconciliation

## Current testbeds
- e-SAF / GlobalTop: integrated process, BOP, utilities, flexible operation and demonstration engineering
- CO2-to-methanol demo plant: BOP constraints, recycle, flexible operability and decision-relevant fidelity
- Other low-carbon systems: dynamic integration, validation and demonstration decisions

## Public-data policy
The website does not disclose confidential plant data, pre-publication patent filings or unvalidated research conclusions.
